items.text: Radioactive decay isarandom（unpredictable)process,just like throwing a coin.lfwethrowa coin wecannotsaywith certaintywhetheritwill come down heads or tails.lfwe throw a thousand coinswe cannot predict which will landheads andwhichwill land tails.The sameis true forradioactive nuclei.It isimpossible to tell whichnuclei will disintegrate(break down) at anyparticular time.However,if wethrewa thousand coinswewouldbe surprisedif the numberthatlanded asheadswasnotaround5oo.Weknow thata normal coin hasan equal chanceof landingasahead ora tail,soifwegot600 headswe would thinkitwasunusual.If theproportion ofheadswere muchgreater than thiswe would beright to thinkthat the coin wasnot fair.
